name: Fee Structure Total
Fee Schedule Total
Payment Link
script:
try: 
    hash = frappe.utils.generate_hash(doc.name,length=20) 
    frappe.db.set_value("Payment Request",doc.name,'payment_hash',hash) 
    url = frappe.utils.get_url() + "/payment?payment_request=" + hash 
    frappe.db.set_value("Payment Request",doc.name,'payment_url',url) 
except Exception as e: 
    frappe.logger('hash').exception(e)

name: Payment Charge
Discount
script:
total_amount = 0
for component in doc.components:
    total_amount = total_amount + component.amount
doc.custom_total_amount = total_amount

for d in doc.custom_discounts:
    discount_doc = frappe.get_doc("Discount Configuration", d.discount_name)
    if discount_doc.type == "One Time":
        discount = discount_doc.discount
        discount_amount = discount_doc.discount_amount
        if discount_amount == 0:
            discounted_amount = (total_amount * float(discount)) / 100
    
            doc.custom_discounted_amount  = discounted_amount
            doc.grand_total = total_amount - discounted_amount
            doc.grand_total_in_words = str(frappe.utils.in_words(doc.grand_total)).title()
            doc.outstanding_amount = doc.grand_total
        else:
            doc.custom_discounted_amount  = discount_amount
            doc.grand_total = total_amount - discount_amount
            doc.grand_total_in_words = str(frappe.utils.in_words(doc.grand_total)).title()
            doc.outstanding_amount = doc.grand_total
